full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric digital painting shows a lone person standing beside a flooded road at the edge of a glowing orange landscape. The horizon is very low, and warm copper and amber sky fills the upper half. A dark cloud bank hangs across the top left, while a bright yellow-orange opening near the center backlights the sparse forms. On a narrow strip of ground at left, a single small tree leans slightly, its rounded foliage drawn as a dense dark silhouette. Several thin posts rise around its base. A small upright figure stands near the middle-right, facing left toward the tree and bright distance. The figure is almost entirely in shadow, with little more than head, torso, and legs readable. At far right, a pale old car is parked on the roadside, partly cropped by the frame. Behind it, a tall dark utility pole rises to the top edge, and several black wires sweep diagonally toward the upper center. The lower half is a broad shallow sheet of still water or wet ground. The tree, figure, car, pole, and luminous sky are reflected in it as softened, elongated shapes. Small dark stones and debris interrupt the mirrored surface. A few birds or tiny airborne dark marks appear across the orange sky. The painting relies on broad transparent glows and rough textured brush patches rather than precise outlines. Deep brown silhouettes and cool gray-green car color stand against saturated gold, burnt orange, and copper. Light is strongest at the low horizon, turning the far land into a pale blaze while the foreground remains warm but dim. The horizontal water plane and minimal silhouettes give the scene a wide, suspended quiet, with the solitary figure caught between the tree and the vehicle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形大气感数字绘画呈现一名独行者站在积水路边，面向橙色发亮景色的边缘。地平线很低，暖铜色与琥珀色天空填满上半幅。一道暗云带悬在左上，中央附近的亮黄橙开口为稀疏形体提供逆光。左侧一条窄陆地上，一棵小树微微倾斜，圆润树冠画成浓暗剪影。几根细柱从根边升起。中右一枚小小直立人影站着，向左面朝树和明亮远方。人物几乎全在阴影里，只能读出头、躯干和腿。最右边，一辆浅色旧车停在路旁，被画框部分裁切。它后方高高的暗电线杆升出顶边，几条黑线斜扫向上方中央。下半幅是一大片浅而静止的水或湿地。树、人、车、杆和发亮天空以柔化拉长的形态映在水里。小暗石和碎物打断镜面。橙天里还有几只鸟或细小飞行暗痕。画作依靠宽阔透明辉光和粗糙有纹理的刷痕，而非精确轮廓。深棕剪影与冷灰绿车色对着饱和金、焦橙和铜色。光在低地平线最强，让远地变成浅色辉光，前景依然暖却较暗。横向水面与极少的剪影给场景开阔、悬停的安静，一人处在树与车之间。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric digital painting spreads saturated amber, copper, and burnt orange in broad glowing layers, interrupted by sparse deep-brown silhouettes. A low luminous band supplies backlight, so narrow vertical marks remain dark and simple against the haze. A wide reflective lower plane doubles the main tonal masses as softened, stretched echoes, with small dark flecks breaking the surface. Edges are crisp only at a few focal contours; most shapes dissolve into grainy color and textured brushwork. Fine diagonal lines counter the strong horizontal division and give the open composition direction. Warm light blooms through mist without a visible hard source, creating a quiet, cinematic sense of distance.
style_prompt_zh: 大气感数字绘画把饱和琥珀、铜与焦橙铺成宽阔发亮层，由稀疏深棕剪影打断。低处一道亮带提供逆光，使狭窄竖向记号在雾前保持深暗而简明。宽阔反光下部平面把主要明暗大块复制成柔化拉长的回声，小暗碎点打断表面。只有少量焦点轮廓锐利，大部分形态溶进颗粒色彩与有纹理的笔触。细斜线抵消强横向分割，让开阔构图有方向。暖光穿过雾晕开，没有可见硬光源，形成安静而有电影感的距离。
